title: IPv4 fragmentation offset in eight bytes
summary: Fragment Offset is the offset relative to the original data area. The field value 3 indicates that the data area is offset by 24 bytes.
applies: Offline IPv4 and IPv6 packet analysis
detail: The offset does not contain the original IP header. Determine the last piece combined with MF; a piece with an offset of zero may just be the first piece.
boundary: Different datagrams cannot be spliced based on offset or arrival order alone.
relevance: When reconstructing fragmented data in offline captures by byte range, avoid reducing the offset by eight times.
